visualReview.notes: Inspected all 12 current portable frames, including four turntable directions, whole-crossing view, arch and spandrels, cutwater pier and hinge, two road levels, third-rail tracks, underside, and curved eastern approach. Corrected arch winding gives four solid concrete ribs in each river span; the two short end spans now have one correctly connected girder system each.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 12 current shared-material/sky-PMREM frames, including north-up placement. Canonical concrete, granite and painted/stainless metal retain the joint relief, rails, thin parapets and pier coursing. Model loading and unloading succeeds.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q2475012 bridge way887624269 and separate roadway/rail centerlines establish anchor[30.56443405,50.442658675], signed heading0.411477488755, native+XENE toward Hydropark and+ZSSE downstream. The 694.601m main road envelope contains the published 672m engineered span system with reconstructed abutment ends; the curving elevated rail approach continues separately to nativeX538.969. Plan fit inspected in the current north-up view. Sea-level91.5m is a provisional published Kaniv normal-pool reference, not a surveyed transformation of Baltic datum to host terrain; local water stage, longitudinal slope and shore grading remain host-dependent.

fidelityReview.notes: 500,220-triangle original detailed exterior of the permanent bridge form: published 40/80/99/117/117/99/80/40m span scheme, four concrete arch ribs with segment joints, open spandrels and hinge hardware, shaped coursed cutwater piers, separate lower roadways and upper central metro, sleepers and clips, 1520mm rails and covered third rail, footways, curbs, markings, open balusters, lamps, drains, and individually curved/graded eastern rail approach. Published dimensions and map plan constrain a photographic reconstruction of heights, rib sections, detailed fittings and support stations. Temporary support arches, piles, jacking frames and barges from the ongoing 2024–2026 works are explicitly omitted; this asset does not claim a completed future restoration, submerged foundations or engineered survey accuracy.
